allowed.description:
Types and methods that are explicitly allowed. If just a type name appears ("Duration"), all methods on that type
are allowed. If a type name and method appears ("Duration#fromString"), only that single method is allowed.

noAutoClear.description:
If true, {@link TestSuite#blockRemote blockRemote} will not be automatically cleared at the end of the test block
that called it. This is most useful in the "before" hook to apply to all cases.

title: Options for TestSuite#blockRemote. Note that by default _all_ remote calls are blocked.
name: TestSuite.BlockRemoteSpec
